name: Code
description: A fragment of code or a literal value, marked up as <code>. Inline code sits in a sentence; the block variant wraps it in <pre> so whitespace is preserved. An optional copy control helps people reuse longer snippets.
summary: Inline or block code, with optional copy
researchNote: Block form is a variant (R6), not a separate Code block entry. Carbon's Code snippet covers inline, single-line and multi-line.

elements.name: Language label
elements.description: Optional label such as "JavaScript" on a block

elements.name: Copy button
elements.description: Copies the snippet; needs a clear name such as "Copy code"

variants.caption: Inline — short literal in a sentence
Block with copy — button copies the snippet

usageNotes: Use <code> for short literals in prose. For a multi-line snippet, wrap it in <pre><code> so indentation and line breaks stay intact.
Don't use <pre> alone for code; put the code in <code> inside it (HTML living standard).
If you offer a copy control, name the button for what it copies ("Copy code"), and confirm success without relying on color alone.
Escape angle brackets in the displayed source so the browser doesn't treat them as markup.
Syntax highlighting is presentation. Keep the underlying text selectable and copyable.
frameworkNotes: Verified Nov 2026 against each live index. Carbon ships Code snippet (inline, single-line, multi-line). Chakra also lists Code Block separately; treated here as the block variant. shadcn/ui lists Code Block. Polaris web components no longer ship InlineCode (use native code). Apple HIG has no code display component.
